This is a Pre-solicitation notice. This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal quotes.  Solicitation, 36C24626Q0545, will be issued on or about 05/01/2026.  The Department of Veterans Affairs, Richmond VAMC, Richmond, VA has a requirement for MRI INFUSION PUMPS. This is a one-time buy.       
Â 
This acquisition is set aside for small businesses.  The applicable NAICS Code is 339112 with a size standard of 1,000 employees.  All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to Stephen.Nasssan@va.gov. Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted.     
Â 
Offerors are responsible for downloading all documents including amendments from Contracting Opportunities at sam.gov website without further notification from the Contracting Officer.
